RETURN p1.production_mt AS production_2019_20, p2.production_mt AS production_2023_24,

MATCH (c:Crop {name: 'Groundnut'})-[p1:PRODUCED_IN {crop_year: '2019-20'}]->(d:District {name: 'Manikganj'}),

WITH p1.production_mt AS production_2019_20, p2.production_mt AS production_2023_24,
     (p2.production_mt - p1.production_mt) AS difference,
     ((p2.production_mt - p1.production_mt) / p1.production_mt) AS percent_change
RETURN CASE
           WHEN percent_change > 0 THEN 'Production increased by ' + toString(difference) + ' MT (' + toString(percent_change * 100) + '%)'
           WHEN percent_change < 0 THEN 'Production decreased by ' + toString(abs(difference)) + ' MT (' + toString(abs(percent_change * 100)) + '%)'
           ELSE 'Production remained the same'
